hypothesised_pattern: An even, U-shaped function of x4 is missing from the base model, which under-predicts when |x4| exceeds about 1 and over-predicts when |x4| is around 0.6 or less.
rationale: Positive residuals coincide with x4 = +1.60, -1.12, -1.26, -1.07, while negative residuals coincide with x4 = +0.57, +0.51, -0.38, -0.32, -0.47, +0.13. Both signs of x4 appear in each group, so the residual tracks |x4|, consistent with an unmodelled x4 squared term.
